# The file tool inside `run`. (from builtin_tools and permissions)

# write, then read it back
exec metagente run notes.ag save text=remember
stdout '^remember$'
exists out/a.txt
grep '^remember$' out/a.txt

# a missing file is explained, with the line
! exec metagente run reader.ag read
stderr 'Problem on line 6 of reader\.ag'
stderr 'the file `notes\.txt` does not exist'
stderr 'looked up from the project folder'

# a scoped tool stays inside its folder
exec metagente run scoped.ag read path=ok.txt
stdout '^fine$'
! exec metagente run scoped.ag read path=../secret.txt
stderr 'outside the folder this agent may use \(data/\)'
! exec metagente run scoped.ag write path=../evil.txt
stderr 'outside the folder this agent may use \(data/\)'
! exists evil.txt

# readonly refuses to write, even though the file exists
! exec metagente check readonly.ag
stderr '`file\.write` is not available because `tool file` was declared readonly'

-- notes.ag --
agent Notes
  goal "Keep notes"
  tool file
  accepts save text
  on save
    file.write path: "out/a.txt" text: text
    back = file.read path: "out/a.txt"
    reply back
-- reader.ag --
agent Reader
  goal "Read a file and show what is in it"
  tool file
  accepts read
  on read
    text = file.read path: "notes.txt"
    reply text
-- scoped.ag --
agent Scoped
  goal "Read inside data only"
  tool file "data/"
  accepts read path
  accepts write path
  on read
    reply file.read path: path
  on write
    file.write path: path text: "x"
    reply "written"
-- readonly.ag --
agent R
  goal "x"
  tool file readonly
  accepts go
  on go
    file.write path: "a" text: "b"
    reply "x"
-- data/ok.txt --
fine
-- secret.txt --
top secret
